title: Late Fee Percentage after Prior Late Fees — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement
content:
**Footnote to the resident account terms of the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.**

The late fee percentage — the percentage of the past-due amount used in the late fee — is set according to the late fees posted on the residency in the 12 whole months before the handling date:

| Late fees posted on the residency in the 12 whole months before the handling date | Late fee percentage |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 3.0 percent |
| Exactly one | 2.0 percent |

A residency with no late fee posted in that window is not governed by this footnote.

**The window.** A late fee counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from the handling date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the posting date. With a hypothetical handling date of 10 June 2026, a late fee posted on 11 June 2025 counts and one posted on 10 June 2025 does not.

### Illustration (hypothetical past-due amount of 6624.00)

- Two prior late fees in the window: 3.0 percent of 6624.00 is 198.72.
- One prior late fee in the window: 2.0 percent of 6624.00 is 132.48.
